correctness.rationale: PASS: The normalized reproducing kernel is exactly 1+(cos(hx)-a_h)(cos(hy)-a_h)/(b_h-a_h^2)+sin(hx)sin(hy)/c_h, where a_h=sin(h)/h, b_h=1/2+sin(2h)/(4h), c_h=1/2-sin(2h)/(4h). Its uniform smooth limit is the quadratic Legendre kernel 1+3xy+5(3x²-1)(3y²-1)/4. At x=1 its simple roots (-1±sqrt(6))/5 bound the negative interval, whose exact integral gives L*=1+12sqrt(6)/25. The diagonal Cauchy–Schwarz norm bound is strictly below L* for |x|<=21/25 and the explicitly factored derivative of the Lebesgue function is strictly positive for 21/25<=x<=1; reflection and uniform smooth perturbation preserve exactly the two endpoint maxima at small h. Expanding the true kernel at x=1 gives -(h²/280)(175y⁴+140y³-90y²-28y-5), whose integral over the moving negative interval contributes -387sqrt(6)/21875 h²; moving roots are O(h²) with zero boundary integrand, hence remainder O(h⁴). Symmetry of K and duality give equal L1 and L∞ norms. Independent symbolic integration checked the radical coefficient, separate from claimed packaged 25 assertions.
